pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's lemma environment at source lines 39025-39033 (label lemma-trick-to-find-good-element, canonical tag 0GVI): for a ring whose quotient by its Jacobson radical is Noetherian and a projective module with infinite rank at every maximal ideal, given elements s and a submodule M generating the whole module one can correct s by an element of M so that the submodule generated by the correction is a free direct summand. The proof environment at source lines 39035-39105 immediately follows it and is its own proof: it first reduces modulo the Jacobson radical and lifts the splitting using projectivity and the unit criterion, then works in the Noetherian case with the vanishing loci of finitely many functionals, shows that any such locus containing a closed point can be strictly decreased using the infinite dimension of a suitable image in the fibre and the finiteness of a Tor group, iterates this in the Noetherian spectrum until the locus is empty and reads the resulting relation as a splitting.
